steps.quote: We report financial results for two segments: Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads, and WhatsApp, as well as third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 12 items
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "share repurchases ($26.26 billion)" and "dividends ($5.32 billion)" and "board's authorization of the share repurchase program", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for rational capital allocation: 434 tokens in, 59 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The filing details cash usage for capital expenditures, share repurchases, dividend payments, taxes related to employee stock awards, and equity investments. It further explains that future capital expenditures are intended to support the company's AI efforts and core business.

steps.title: Critic re-checked the repaired items
details: Only the items that were sent back are checked again.

steps.title: Critic: explanation check had nothing to judge
details: No repaired item needed a second look.

steps.title: Critic: quote check passed for 1 item
Critic: language check passed for 1 item
Critic model call: 1,002 tokens in, 136 out, ~$0.0005 at paid rates
details: The model judged whether the quoted sentences support each finding's verdict and rationale.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 1 item
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The quotes provided describe prior-year comparatives, not the fiscal year ending 2025-12-31. No quantified actions for the latest fiscal year are provided.

steps.title: Critic's final result: rational capital allocation warning
details: Each repaired item was checked once more and now passes.
